dct_creator_sm: Schutten, Kerry (Department of Pathobiology. Ontario Veterinary College. University of Guelph.).
dct_description_sm: This dataset describes the analysis of regurgitated pellets collected from four communal turkey vulture (Cathartes aura) roosts in southern Ontario over three years (2021-2023). The pellets were analyzed for anthropogenic debris (plastics and other garbage), in addition to types of natural non-digestible materials.
dct_title_s: Turkey vulture (Cathartes aura) ingested plastics data
